lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: That gate will be the talk of every dinner table in the noble quarter tomorrow. Venture and Tekiel will be at each other's throats within the week.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: And when they're done tearing at each other?

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Fewer swords pointed at us when it counts. That's the whole plan, Vin — a hundred small fires, and the Lord Ruler too busy to notice the one that actually matters.
